implementationCommitLocator: Containing implementation commit; exact resulting hosted run required
scope: Read-only installed runtime payload identification as a prerequisite for a separately verified side-by-side package transition
candidateBehavior: Use only the exact installed package-info command after the existing complete canonical installation, immutable inventory and strict recorded dynamic-dependency validation.
Report sorted code-relative runtime file paths with bounded byte counts, allowed modes and SHA256 records; exclude configuration, session, prefix and host-library paths.
Compute canonical complete runtime and operator-only payload fingerprints and expose the native binary hash separately.

Exclude build records, source labels, archive timestamps, documentation, declarative example files, licenses and installation/provenance metadata from payload fingerprints, while retaining complete existing installation verification.
Acquire no alpha lock, write no state, invoke no native executable, activate no service and grant no package compatibility or transition authority.
Return finite redacted package_info_refused failures without paths; preserve the existing full native and installed-runtime contracts.

hostedVerification.expectedEvidence: Actual extracted-bundle package-info output, exact native/operator fingerprints, absence of management mutation and existing native/service regressions.

acceptedPriorRestoredService.scope: Same-package restored HTTP configuration in fresh temporary nonroot systemd-user installation/unit only

limitations: Payload fingerprints are checked consistency observations, not cryptographic authentication, state or ABI compatibility, or an atomic filesystem/process fence.
No actual package staging, switching, migration, start, restore or rollback is performed.
Metadata-only or archive/provenance-only changes do not qualify as meaningfully different runtime packages.
The new operator payload may differ while the native NGINX binary remains identical; report those claims separately.
Local pure and virtual controls are not physical native/service or distinct-runtime-package A-to-B-to-A acceptance.
Previous historical local cleanup FAIL_UNKNOWN, unexercised actual failure containment, CLA failure and unknown historical causes remain preserved through the mandatory checkpoint history.
Meaningful A-to-B-to-A/state compatibility, permanent distribution, independent published replay,60-minute soak, fullG3/G4/V1 and semantic Continuum remain open.

separateInstalledCommandControl.scope: Actual Node command and private synthetic installation; native placeholder not executed, unrelated test callbacks filtered.

separateIndependentReviewControls.scope: Pure or virtual security controls; not added to selected TAP count

unpublishedDraftValidationHistory.cause: The exported helper placement entered a captured source-extracted test region. Source placement was corrected before final freeze; no physical native result or product vulnerability is inferred.
